content: SaaS QR platforms (Uniqode, QRLynx, Scanheim, QR TIGER) onboard teammates by admin email invite plus RBAC; Uniqode Editors see/edit only their own resources while Admins see everything. NFC/print-shop tools (NFCTagify, ixkio, ZAPPED) instead assign tags/cards per person: admin reassigns custody, the chip stores a stable public URL, destination changes server-side. Internal ops tools skip public signup and provision accounts. PlateFlow v1 should follow the NFC asset model (admin-created users, per-QR owner + assignment, no shared library) not SaaS self-serve seats.
